name: en-marketing-vague
text:
Privacy

We respect your privacy. Your data is safe with us and our trusted partners.

We may use your information to improve your experience and to show you offers you might like.

We keep your data as long as we need it for business purposes.

You can contact us at any time to ask about your data.

By using this site you agree to this policy.
reasoning: A marketing agency’s policy written to sound complete while saying little, read under Danish law. Five elements are touched on without commitment and so undetermined: purposes, recipients, retention, rights and automated decisions. The controller and six more are not there at all. The fixture that punishes a generous reading.
